comment: MiniDAQ's design and development file (Chapter 16): the design and development clauses of ISO 13485:2016 and the related QMS clauses, with the documents and records that are their evidence. Topics are named in this book's words. tools/design_file.py checks the index, document control and the generated design-file.md (test docs.design_file).
intro: For each clause of ISO 13485:2016 that concerns design and development, the documents and records of MiniDAQ that a reviewer or an auditor opens first. In a real product these are part of the scanner's design and development file, kept in the manufacturer's document management system (assumption: confirm with team where your scanner's file is kept).

clauses.topic: Validation of software used in the quality system
clauses.note: Every tool whose output is in the product or is evidence, with its class, the reasons for confidence and what shows it can fail; the versions are checked on every CI run and the gates are shown to fail by the gate self-test (Chapter 20).
Version and history of every controlled document, checked on every change; a changed document gets a new version before the next release.
Generated records are checked against their sources; measurements keep their raw output.
Software part of the ISO 14971 file (Chapter 15), and the security risk assessment: threat model and vulnerability triage (Chapter 17).
Requirements from the intended use, the regulations, the risk controls and the performance budget.
Architecture with classified items, data formats, the code and its coding standard.

Decisions with their alternatives (ADRs), and the review at the end of each Part, recorded in the release notes. The review of each change that SDP section 5 asks for is the subject of internal audit finding A-1 (Chapter 16); since Chapter 21 it follows the code review checklist.
The system test plan and its reports (Chapter 19); every requirement traced to its tests or its measurement; six presets and static analysis on every change; the soak of each release.

clauses.plan: Validation is of the scanner in its use environment: system tests (Part IV) and phantom measurements of image quality (Chapter 30). MiniDAQ alone cannot be validated.

clauses.note: Release process and record (SDP section 8): tagged source, book files, SBOM and the release record of each version; since Chapter 20 a reproducible product archive and an evidence archive bound to it by its SHA-256.

clauses.topic: Control of design and development changes
clauses.note: Change requests with impact analysis and approval (Chapter 16).
Every SOUP item identified by its pin, with its requirements and its known-anomaly review.

In MiniDAQ, problems found by tests, fuzzing, measurements and reviews; at the scanner, complaints and service reports as well. From MDQ-PR-019 on, each closed report records its root cause analysis (Chapter 21).
The audit of Chapter 16, by the author (no independent auditor in a teaching project).
Every problem evaluated for safety; the open ones are stated by each release.
CAPA records with investigation, actions and effectiveness check (Chapter 16).
Preventive actions become rules of the coding standard or checks in CI.
